purpose: Independent episode-level predictor gate for inference-time partial-horizon teacher-prefix hybrids, using the eight tasks reserved and untouched by the prior ranker evaluation.

prior_use_audit.historical_use: These eight episodes were not found in prior score, episode evaluation, model-output, or ranker-training artifacts. They were listed as the reserved untouched set and later used only as metadata exclusions in a separate episode-selection manifest. During static preparation, collection_manifest.json val/untouched task metadata was viewed; no validation/untouched banks, costs, model outputs, or evaluation results were opened or used for selection.
prior_use_audit.old_ranker_validation: Uses the disjoint first eight reserved episodes; this gate does not read or score their banks or per-task outputs.
prior_use_audit.audit_limit: Static audit covered workspace freezes, source, reports, and small JSON/TXT summaries; it did not load bank tensors or model-output archives.

scope.stage: independent episode-level predictor gate on newly generated student-only CEM banks
scope.treatment_identity: Inference-time horizon hybrid only: teacher prefix, then frozen h256 student continuation from the latest teacher latent as H1.
scope.episode_independence: The eight task IDs were reserved and not scored before this freeze. The official dataset-wide preprocessing fit may include train columns for these task rows; this is task-level episode independence, not row-level preprocessing isolation.
scope.after_gate: A GO permits only a separately frozen adaptive-CEM evaluation; it does not authorize deployment or closed-loop evaluation.

collection.teacher_shadow: Compute official teacher criterion costs for the same candidate arrays and captured contexts; never feed them to CEM.
collection.noninterference: For selection orders 24-27, run paired student-only episodes with shadow capture disabled/enabled from the same seed protocol; require exact equality of task/reset, RNG states, candidate arrays and solver updates, committed actions, post-step states, solve counts, and captured contexts. Stop before other tasks or scoring unless all four pairs pass.
collection.bank_storage: Write newly generated independent banks only under the current PBS artifact directory; do not read old ranker validation banks.

arms.definition: For each of the same 300 candidate action sequences, use official LeWM predict for the first k horizons. If k<5, pass the latest teacher latent as a length-one state to the frozen h256 student for the remaining 5-k horizons. Concatenate predictions and score with the official criterion.

controls.k0: all five horizons from treatment_step1000 student
controls.k5: all five horizons from official teacher

arms.ranking: torch.topk(cost, k=30, largest=False, sorted=True), matching the pinned official CEM elite operator.

validity.bank_count: Exactly three full banks per reached t0/t25 replan: rounds 10/20/30; no task replacement.
validity.required_cost_controls: Recomputed k0 student and k5 teacher costs must match the same newly captured bank costs by torch.allclose for every bank before any hybrid quality result is reported.
validity.nonfinite_or_missing: Fail closed; do not drop a bank or episode.

metrics.normalized_elite_regret: (mean saved teacher cost for scorer top30 - mean saved teacher cost for teacher top30) / population_std of all 300 teacher costs; lower is better.
metrics.top30_recall: Scorer top30 overlap with teacher top30 divided by 30.
metrics.latency: Synchronized native predictor plus official criterion milliseconds per 300 candidates, including teacher/student switching; cached inputs resident on CUDA; exclude bank/model I/O and environment.
metrics.strata: Report t0/t25 and rounds 10/20/30 separately. Episode is the statistical unit; median over that episode's available paired banks before summaries.

timing.arm_order: Deterministically rotate the order across repeats.

gate.go_if_either: k1 or k2 meets every quality, timing, control, noninterference, and coverage condition.
gate.episode_aggregation: Within each episode take the median of paired bank-level hybrid-minus-k0 regret deltas; summarize over all eight episodes. For each CEM round, first take each episode's median across available t0/t25 banks.
gate.inconclusive: Fewer than six t25 episodes, failed noninterference, or any invalid/missing bank/cost alignment.
gate.post_gate: GO allows only a newly frozen adaptive-CEM gate; no automatic deployment or closed-loop claim.

execution.allocation: One PBS GPU compute-node job performs runtime setup, 4 paired noninterference checks, collection of all eight student-only episodes, and full-bank predictor scoring/timing.
